boundaries: This joins already validated corpora; replayed source files are disjoint and imported units deduplicate by module plus native structural-name hash.
A use elsewhere in a family does not mark a historical candidate; matching requires its original native key, kind and source binding.
A witness marks an entire historical unit, not necessity of every line. Stage2 range correspondence is not creation provenance.
Missing observations are not unusedness. Root, symbolic-name, attribute, reflective and runtime coverage remains incomplete.
Physical spans are historical raw LF units; changed historical files remain drift, never remapped. Provenance labels do not certify handwriting.
Per-file output replacement is not a batch transaction; interrupted outputs require successful --check or regeneration before use.
settling_measurement: An isolated removal replay of the complete affected-root suite on an authorized valid baseline, recording native symbolic, macro and attribute dependencies.
verdict: No historical candidate receives an imported snapshot dependency witness or exact stage2 range correspondence in this measured corpus. This does not certify unusedness or deletability; full-root liveness remains unresolved.
